title: omakase-ee-provider/1
description: The manifest of one release of a D1 end-effector provider: the package that carries it, the SDK contract it serves, how a side's unit runs it, the configuration it reads, the models it drives and the conformance run that passed. A robot's fit document references a provider by `{id, version}`; the manifest is complete offline, read from a local file or from a hub registry. Rules a JSON Schema cannot state (SemVer ranges, the `{side}` placeholder, the program path, the registry key's file name, posture lengths) are checked by `d1fw-ee-manifest check`.

schema.description: The document type and its major version.

id.description: `<vendor>.<name>`, lowercase: the name a fit document references the provider by, with `version`; for a provider the artifacts hub distributes, also its registry entry name.

version.description: The release, equal to the Debian package's version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no pre-release or build suffix.

package.description: The Debian package this release installs from. `plane: "apt"`: the package is installed by name and version from an apt source (the hub's signed apt suites, a vendor's own source) or is already installed with dpkg; the manifest names no bytes and needs no hub. `plane: "registry"`: the .deb is a content-addressed artifact on the hub's manifest plane, beside the manifest, and `key`, `sha256` and `sizeBytes` are its registry entry's fields; a consumer downloads `baseUrl + "/" + key`, checks the digest and the size, and installs it with dpkg. For `apt` the three fields are absent.

name.description: The package name as its control stanza spells it.

plane.description: Where the package comes from: `apt` (an apt source or a local dpkg install) or `registry` (an artifact on the hub's manifest plane).

key.description: `plane: registry` only: the .deb's key relative to the hub's baseUrl (`<type>/<name>/<version>/<selector-values>/<filename>`), its file name `<name>_<version>_<arch>.deb`.

sha256.description: `plane: registry` only: the SHA-256 of the .deb, lowercase hex.

sizeBytes.description: `plane: registry` only: the size of the .deb, bytes.

sdk.description: What the provider was built against.

contract.description: The shared-memory contract the provider serves.

d1_ee_sdk.description: A SemVer range (Cargo syntax, e.g. ">=0.2.0, <0.3.0") of the d1-ee-sdk releases the provider builds with.

command.description: The `EE_PROVIDER_COMMAND` template: an absolute program path under `/opt/<package>/bin/` and its arguments, separated by single spaces. `{side}` is the only placeholder and must appear. The unit word-splits the value without a shell parse, so quoting and shell syntax are refused.

config_dir.description: The absolute directory of the provider's per-side configuration file. No placeholder.

config_file.description: The file name of a side's configuration inside `config_dir`; `{side}` is the only placeholder and must appear.

config_schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of the per-side configuration file, its TOML read as JSON. `$schema`, when present, names draft 2020-12.

models.description: Every model this release drives, as its descriptor announces it.

guard_models.description: Every collision envelope id a descriptor of this release declares as `guard_model`.

calibration.description: Whether the provider needs a per-robot calibration.

required.description: `true`: the fit supplies a calibration file, appended to the side's configuration file.

conformance.description: The conformance run this release passed.

version.description: The harness release the run used; inside `sdk.d1_ee_sdk`.

run_url.description: Optional: where the run that executed `conformance::lifecycle` against the released commit is recorded: an https URL of a CI run, an absolute path of a local run log, or a hex digest (the commit the run was made on, or the SHA-256 of its log). Nothing in a manifest needs a network to be read.

name.description: A descriptor name (model, driver, guard envelope id): at most 64 bytes, no whitespace or control character.

links.description: How the device can be reached: the arm's flange channel (relayed by the daemon), CAN or CAN FD on an interface of the robot's computer, a USB serial adapter, or Ethernet.

joints.description: The number of joints the descriptor declares for this model.

postures.description: Named joint postures, each one value per joint in the descriptor's joint order: a fraction of that joint's range, 0 its `min` and 1 its `max`. A model with joints names at least `open` and `closed`.
